services.desc: Duration Each Flight is 8-12 minutes depending on weather conditions. blurb: Guests parasail over Fort Lauderdale Beach, flying up to 3 people at once on public flights or up to 12 on private tours. Flights last 8-10 minutes within excursions of approximately 90 minutes for public and 120 minutes for private tours. The boat departs from a location near the corner of Los Olas and Sea Breeze Blvd, one block from the beach.
